_secrets: NEVER put real API keys in this file. Use: dotnet user-secrets set "Ai:Providers:groq:ApiKey" "<key>"

Ai._chain: 'dev' is last on purpose - the chain skips unconfigured providers, so a real key takes precedence automatically.

_models: Each feature may override the provider's Model. The provider default must still be set - an override alone does not make a provider usable. Coach runs once per assessment and needs strict JSON, so it wants the more capable model; chat runs on every message and only needs short answers.
